title: Top Esports Defeat IG and Qualify for LoL Worlds 2026
summary: Top Esports Defeat IG and Qualify for LoL Worlds 2026  Insider Gaming
content:
Top Esports (TES) defeated Invictus Gaming (IG) 3-1 in the LPL Regional Finals and qualified for theLeague of LegendsWorld Championship.

This is much to the dismay of some LPL fans, as TES has lost all nine of its series against LCK teams in their last three international appearances.

TES is now the 12th team to qualify for this year’s event, and the third Chinese team alongside Bilibili Gaming (BLG) and LPL champions Anyone’s Legend.

However, IG and Kang ‘TheShy’ Seung-lok still have one more chance at Worlds qualification, as they’ll face the winner of JD Gaming and Team WE.

title: Top Esports will be the LPL's third representative in Worlds 2026
summary: Top Esports will be the LPL's third representative in Worlds 2026  gosugamers.net
content:
Top Esports are the third team from the LPL to qualify for Worlds 2026 (Image: Riot Games).

Top Esports(TES) will be the third representative for China's League of Legends Pro League (LPL) in the 2026 League of Legends World Championship after they defeatedInvictus Gaming(IG), 3-1, in the upper bracket finals of the LPL 2026 Regional Finals on Thursday (17 September).

TES will joinAnyone's Legend(AL) andBilibili Gaming(BLG) in representing the LPL in this year's Worlds, which is set to kick off in New York City in 15 October. The fourth and final spot for the LPL in Worlds 2026 is still up for grabs between IG,Team WE, andJD Gaming(JDG). All four LPL representatives will start Worlds 2026 in the Swiss Stage, which will take place in Allen, Texas from 23 to 31 October.

TES secured their spot in this year's world championship despite mixed results in the season so far. In March, they only finished 5th-6th in LPL 2026 Split 1. They then failed to qualify for the League of Legends Esports World Cup 2026 after only placing 7th-8th in the tournament's Chinese regional qualifier.

TES then improved in LPL 2026 Split 2, finishing second to BLG and earning a spot in the 2026 Mid-Season Invitational (MSI). However, they faltered against international competition and were knocked out of MSI 2026 in 7th-8th place. Their poor form continued to the LPL 2026 Split 3, where they finished 7th-8th.

But thanks to ranking third in the LPL's Championship Points standings, TES earned another shot at qualifying for Worlds 2026 through the LPL 2026 Regional Finals. Matched up against TES in the upper bracket finals were IG, who positioned fourth in the standings.
